about: The live menu for planner v2.1: the public LibriVox clips a live run may use. The planner rebuilds its clip_id enum from this file on every request, so adding a clip needs no code change. Each excerpt's intact 16 kHz mono wav is on stillhere/public_audio_allowlist.txt. A plan for a stimulus that is not on this menu ends on its evidence panel, never on a live clip's output. alice_ch02 is first because it is the only clip that starts and ends on whole sentences (10 sentences), and the planner defaults to the first clip. public_scan names a public fMRI dataset that played this stretch of audio, or null; checked Oct 29 against Narratives (OpenNeuro ds002345), Le Petit Prince (OpenNeuro ds003643) and the Alice Datasets (OpenNeuro ds002322): only the Alice Datasets used an Alice chapter, chapter 1 (Brennan and Hale's EEG also used chapter 1; EEG, not a scan). The page's end line follows public_scan (cloud plan of Oct 29, 19:20 UTC, 1a).

public_scan.note: Bhattasali et al. 2020 (LREC) used this LibriVox reading of chapter 1 (744 s); our 60-100 s window is inside it

le_petit_prince.line: Le Petit Prince is not on the live menu, so this plan ends on its evidence panel: the held-out section 8 result.
